scientific_limitations: Canonical edge-coordinate Euclidean norm; arbitrary geometric edge-length weighting is not included.
Polygon triangulations have no interior vertices; the result does not classify the minimum inradius over triangulations.
The maximum-path comparison invokes the published all-walk extremal theorem; only its geometric application and related metric claims are assessed here.
Historical priority not independently certified; an equivalent unindexed treatment remains possible.
title: Sharp Euclidean inradius among symmetric homology polytopes of polygon triangulations
